author: /root/environment_review
scope: Focused B03 test-oracle and guide correction for Task-02 Linux CI cancellation race; production implementation unchanged

reviewed_assertions: Pre-next-fetch stop is synchronized by a full one-row adapter channel with no consumer
That leg requires one retained row, EOF, stopped/native-retired/progress-removed receipt, usable connection and same physical marker
In-worker interruption is synchronized by an actual SQLx SQLite collation callback, not actor activity or elapsed delay
The callback has a 15-second bounded receive and explicit-release success observation; timeout/disconnect cannot pass as valid interruption
The callback uses stable comparison semantics and no panic-through-FFI path
The worker leg requires exact Interrupted and all retirement/progress-removal/connection-usability assertions
An old canceled token is followed by a fresh 5000-row aggregate with exact result12502500; old token reuse and pre-cancel rejection remain
Final active/queued/input budgets and active operation observation must be zero

verification.metadataErratumRequested: The actual-jit environmentOverrides dictionary was later mutated to the AOT root; original result is preserved and explicit actual JIT/AOT path addendum requested.

receipt_erratum.resolved_finding: JIT recorded environment dictionary was later mutated by AOT setup. Actual subprocess environments were independent copies. Immutable original receipt preserved and actual JIT/AOT roots explicitly corrected.

review_conclusion: The fix deterministically distinguishes the legal stopped-EOF path from actual in-worker SQLite progress interruption. No result is accepted through an arbitrary fallback. Retirement, progress-handler removal, usable same physical connection, stale generation and clean budgets remain required; stale-generation coverage is strengthened beyond a constant SELECT.
normal_ci: This review does not claim a later normal CI or merge result. The original failed run is retained; the batch coordinator owns subsequent ordinary CI and merge validation.
